items.text: Save place drops a pin where you click and asks its name; while a scene is geolocated it drops numbered leads in the scene's colour, gone once the scene is proved.
Places and Media are two map layers of their own, both on, so a place you save is always seen; captures stay in the Saved panel.
A proof saved with no place yet keeps its scene geolocated: the pill opens that proof with your new captures, and its point map lists the scene's leads.
A place is one drop, red until its card gives it a colour, and a Names switch writes each name under it.
A scene's leads are counted beside its captures, in the To-do, the pill and Inspect.
Tick Layers on the map to capture the map as drawn, each source credited on the picture.
The Geolocating pill lists what its scene gathered, deletes a capture or a frame from there, and links to Inspect, Satellite and Horizon, in the app and the extension.
Make the proof says when a scene has no map capture yet, and takes you to the map.
Geo Report is now Post: the same tool, for more kinds of posts.
Bluesky posts now mention a real Bluesky handle, @geoconfirmed.org by default.
Align has its own seat on the map: the line through two things lined up in a picture, run on; draw a few and they meet near the camera.
Reading a shadow moved from Measure to Sun and moon, one press when you want it, and the slider goes to the hour it gives.
Media's Unused filter finds the files nothing uses, and every delete says what it touches before it runs.
The Google basemap keeps its credit and logo in plain sight.
A plate's map hides one feature, or everything a layer held before a day you pick.
A plate's bar stays still on busy days, scrolls its steps with the wheel, and plays hour by hour when you ask.
Right-click a plate's marker that shows a video or a photo to set it on the page, pointing at its place.
Horizon's Side by side is live: the photo above, the terrain under it, locked together or each on its own.
A note's Columns set two pictures side by side at one height, or words beside a picture, in the PDF and on the web.
Reference windows open over the Horizon view too, the same ones as on the map.
Inspect searches a part of a picture: draw a zone over it, then press Google Lens, Yandex, Bing or TinEye.
A file's mark plays it in its card, a stack one at a time, and Play beside the map takes it to the panel where it was.
Move place on a place's card picks it up and puts it down where you click. A proof's point is moved in its proof.
A proof's point is filed without a question, and where its video stands the map shows the video alone, with the proof's dot.
Deleting a proof takes its geolocation with it, and restoring it from the Trash puts it back.
Save place's arrow offers Save zone: click its corners, name it, and a click in the area opens its card. Edit footprint drags its corners.
Click a lead to pick it, then press Delete to remove it.

pages.title: 3D is here
pages.text: Press 3D on the map and the imagery stands on its relief. Tilt, turn and fly down into any valley.

pages.label: Drawing tools
pages.title: Create your own map!
pages.text: Draw markers, lines and areas with your own icons, every change dated, then send it to My Maps or a KMZ.

pages.title: Maps ready to publish
pages.text: Start from a ready plate, set its look, and export an image, a PDF or a video of its days.

pages.label: View · Overlay · Find
pages.title: Horizon
pages.text: Stand on any point and see its skyline. Find ranks the places whose relief fits a photo's skyline.

pages.title: And also

items.text: Measure turns a line into range rings, a view cone or a line of sight.
Reference windows fade and play clips over the map.
Collage straightens a panorama.
Media opens in one full-screen viewer.

pages.help: The guide now shows every tool in pictures, and walks three tasks step by step.
